# Tuhfat-Al-Ilm Academy

> Tuhfat-Al-Ilm Academy is an international online Islamic academy providing structured one-on-one Quranic recitation, Tajweed, Hifz (memorization), Arabic language, and comprehensive Islamic studies for children and adults worldwide.

Tuhfat-Al-Ilm Academy connects qualified male and female Islamic scholars and certified Huffaz with students across the globe via Zoom and Google Meet, featuring flexible scheduling, personalized pacing, and complimentary trial classes.

## Programs & Curriculum

- [Quran Reading / Nazra (with Tajweed)](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/nazra): Comprehensive Quran reading from Noorani Qaida to full Quran recitation with proper Makharij and phonetics.
- [Hifz-ul-Quran (Memorization)](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/hifz): Structured memorization program with systematic daily lessons (Sabaq), revision (Sabqi), and cumulative retention (Manzil).
- [Tajweed-ul-Quran Rules](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/tajweed): In-depth study of articulation points (Makharij), characteristics (Sifaat), and classical recitation rules.
- [Quran Translation & Tafseer](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/translation): Word-by-word Urdu and English translation, contextual commentary, and practical reflection.
- [Children's Islamic Education](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/children): Engaging curriculum covering foundational beliefs, Islamic manners (Adaab), daily prayers, and prophetic stories.
- [Basic Islamic Knowledge (Farz Uloom)](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/basic-islamic): Essential obligations including Salah, Taharah (purification), Fasting, and Halal/Haram guidance.
- [Comprehensive Islamic Studies](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/islamic-studies): Intermediate curriculum exploring Aqeedah, Fiqh, Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and Hadith studies.
- [Dua & Daily Sunnah](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/dua-sunnah): Masnoon supplications for waking, eating, sleeping, protection, and daily Sunnah practices.
- [Islah & Character Development](https://tuhfatalilm.online/courses/islah): Spiritual purification, emotional discipline, humility, and moral excellence.
